title: Resources: virtual CPU, memory, disk and acceleration

videos.script: A guest has processors, memory and a disk. None of them is real. Each is made out of something the host has, and this lesson looks at how. {{made}} A virtual processor is a thread on the host. It runs when the host's scheduler gives it a turn, on whichever real processor is free. {{cpu}} A guest's memory is taken from the host only when the guest touches it. And on the computer this course is recorded on, something else takes more than the guest does. You will find out what. {{memory}} A guest's disk grows when the guest writes. When the guest deletes, the file does not shrink, unless the guest tells the host, and the host is set to listen. {{disk}} And the devices a guest sees can be imitations of real hardware, or devices made for guests. The second kind is faster, and needs a driver. {{virtio}}
